function.name: get_stock_analysis
function.description: Generates a mobile-friendly stock performance chart for a specified symbol. The chart is optimized for smaller screens (5x3, 60 DPI).

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).

period.description: The time period for historical data. Valid values: 1d, 5d, 1wk, 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 2y, 5y, 10y, ytd, max. Default is 1w (mapped to 1wk).
